subject: pig
scope: Still keys only; no motion approval. First six board tiles compared with design.png and selected source contact sheets.

identity.verdict: The boxy nested snout and large body persist, but the later keys replace the original sparse forked stick legs with thick, outlined forelimbs continuous with a more constructed chest. That changes this exact doodle into a more conventionally drawn pig.

source_pose.verdict: The sequence clearly changes from a left-facing side stance into a forward three-quarter approach with alternating front-leg reaches and a lower, nearer snout, matching the main source pose progression.

one_gap_that_matters_most: Late-key forelegs gain outlined mass absent from the chosen doodle.
smallest_repair: In keys 3-6, keep the current turned body, head placement and alternating foot positions, but replace the broad outlined foreleg shapes with the original single-line, forked leg vocabulary, attached beneath the body.
must_not_be_lost: Nested angular square snout and deliberately absent eyes
Large uneven body contour and angular ear character
Readable forward turn and alternating leg reach already present
Original sparse line economy; do not add anatomical detail
